name: AI Level Studio
description: Pick a song and a difficulty - the AI listens to the music, thinks on a black screen and builds a decorated level.

think-depth.name: Thinking depth
think-depth.description: How many level variants the AI composes and tests for every part of the song. 1 = quick, 5 = maximum (can take a while on a phone).

open-mode.name: When the level is ready
open-mode.description: Where to go after the black screen: the level page (play / edit from there) or straight into the editor.

sync-offset.name: Sync offset (ms)
sync-offset.description: Obstacles feel late? Use a negative value. Too early? Use a positive value.
